question: What means establishing the oneness of body and so forth with consciousness is being declared?
premises: A means is to be explained.
This means establishes oneness with consciousness.
The oneness includes the body and so forth.
inference: The speaker declares a means that establishes the oneness of body and other elements with consciousness.
plain_english: I tell and declare the means that establishes the oneness of the body and so forth with consciousness.
